components.name: Puzzle Card
components.description: White framed mat holding the rébus image with a difficulty badge.

components.name: Difficulty Badge (medium)
components.description: Corner badge; fill encodes difficulty, symbols carry the clues.

narrative.overview: Rébusárna is a pack of picture cards you flip through. Each rébus sits in a white, rounded card that takes the stage; everything around it is stock Material 3, tonal and quiet, generated from a single indigo seed (#3F51B5) in both light and dark. The mood is calm and focused: surfaces stay out of the way so the player can think, and saturated color appears only where it carries information.
keyCharacteristics: Material 3 with ColorScheme.fromSeed (indigo #3F51B5), light and dark; no custom fonts.
The puzzle card is the signature: white mat, 24px corners, image inset 6px.
Difficulty is the only saturated color system; always paired with symbols and a text tooltip.
Large touch targets: buttons at least 52px tall, icon buttons 48px.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Saturated color means difficulty, favorite, or correct. Never use teal, yellow or red as decoration or for non-difficulty states.

rules.name: The Label-Behind-Color Rule
rules.body: A color never stands alone: the badge always carries symbols and a tooltip naming the difficulty in Czech.

rules.name: The Czech-Diacritics Rule
rules.body: Every text style must render Czech diacritics without clipping.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the puzzle card casts a shadow; every other surface is tonal and flat.

dos: Do let the puzzle image dominate each screen; keep surrounding chrome tonal.
Do derive all non-difficulty color from the indigo seed via the Material scheme.
Do pair difficulty color with symbols and a Czech text label.
Do keep touch targets at 48px or larger, and keep the layout working at 360px.
donts: Don't use teal, yellow or red for anything but difficulty (or red for favorite).
Don't add a second shadow style or lift other surfaces.
Don't introduce a custom typeface or decorative display type.
Don't make search, browsing or answer-revealing UI prominent; the game depends on not trivializing it.
